Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ - Return - Type E_ OK: The call of the Flex Ray Driver's API service has returned E_ OK. E_ NOT_ OK: The call of the Flex Ray Driver's API service has returned E_ NOT_ OK, or an error has been detected in development mode. Description Initialized a Flex Ray CC. Available via Fr If.h
